comparison.objective: Dispose of a used insulin syringe correctly while preserving the vial and glucose meter.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective sorting and safe placement of a sharp object.
comparison.success_condition: Syringe in sharps container, not kitchen bin; vial and meter are not discarded.
comparison.reason: Hazard-aware cleanup and classification differ from mechanical commissioning and force-limited locking. No spec versions are available.
